source_identity_correlation.scope: Offline exact generated marker and DXGI sampled presentation correlation; no GPU activity
caveats: An unobserved Present ID is not proof it was never displayed: GetFrameStatistics is sampled.
Adjacent observed VBlanks whose Present IDs skip an intermediate ID establish that intermediate cannot occupy its own VBlank.
Explicitly presented but absent from encoded output proves a miss after source presentation somewhere before AU, not specifically a DDA timeout without native Acquire metadata.

nonblocking_submission_ledger.interpretation: 111 source long-gap excess slots and 62 catch-up bursts exactly match 111 output repeats and 62 omitted submitted IDs; consistent with preserving presentation cadence while excluding catch-up submissions, not proof every omission is compositor-caused. Zero omitted IDs were explicitly observed presented; sparse samples leave 35 IDs fully ambiguous.

native_fresh_wait_regression.scope: Exact source-function CPU mocks, including nonblocking-only acquisition, pointer/lease cleanup, shared deadline, maximum budget and late timer wake. Not Windows timing guarantees.

limits: 100 fps encoded average does not prove 100 unique source pictures.
Selected research run still contains 111 repeated IDs and 62 omitted submitted IDs; sparse DXGI presentation samples leave 35 omitted IDs fully ambiguous.
The submission ledger is consistent with source long gaps and catch-up bursts, but does not prove every omission is compositor-caused.
USB completion is host driver completion, not goggles decode or photons-on-lens latency.
Source render-start age includes the generated fixture presentation queue; it is not capture latency alone.
Neither every interval within +/-1% nor optical latency within +/-1% has been established.
USB bulk transfers and Windows timers are not hard real time; late frames remain possible.
Recovered protocol exposes no closed-loop goggles presentation timestamps.

The valid final primary host-only 20-second run retains two repeated IDs and two omitted source IDs that were explicitly observed presented. This residual pipeline sampling issue is unresolved; the successful extended-display USB run does not establish zero omissions for both sources.

usb-final-production-decoder-timeout-hos.reason: USB run reached its duration and cleaned up, but an 85-second outer wrapper ended during offline decoding. No completed source-identity report; excluded from dynamic acceptance.

usb-final-production-invalid-source-host.reason: USB writes completed, but the generated marker was invalid throughout the decoded run, consistent with source occlusion/invisibility. All inferred identity and source-age metrics are invalid; excluded from dynamic acceptance.

final_source_preflight.controller: Existing extended renderer window selected by owning PID and class, then temporarily set HWND_TOPMOST with SWP_NOACTIVATE. Original renderer binary was not rebuilt for this measurement.

excluded_primary_runs.reason: Source window partly obscured by another application; marker image confirmed overlap. Not cadence acceptance data.
excluded_primary_runs.control_fix: Hidden-console launch and bounded topmost renderer; verify visibility and marker identities.

excluded_final_primary_hidden_startup.reason: Inherited hidden startup state prevented a valid visible synthetic source. Marker validation failed; all inferred identity and source-age metrics are invalid and are omitted.
